subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is 'awareness'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given blank needs a word that would describe the perception of adult life.
 
• For this purpose, the correct word is awareness. 
 
• Awareness means knowledge or perception of a situation or fact.
 
• Thus, option 2 is the correct answer. 

 

*Correct passage__ - **As the education of girls becomes similar (1) to that of boys, their home life will also become similar. Their present greater (2) knowledge of domestic affairs will also disappear. After a (3) certain age, boys and girls should have a share in parental occupations and (4) anxieties, but not in excess as it would interfere with their education. Yet, (5) __**awareness**__ of the problems of adult life helps boys and girls understand and appreciate the efforts of their parents.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• The meanings of the other options are as follows - 
 
 
• **Alertness - **the quality of being alert.
 
• **Aloofness - **the quality or state of being aloof or emotionally distant 
 
• **Attentiveness - **the action of paying close attention to something.
